## Source: amazon-inspector (430a8463ba4e5ea6b5dcb99d7410212773157b1c609d78b5a43bdf0cf9cd6c1b)
package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs an inline Node command reading os.hostname() and issuing an HTTP GET to <hostname>.<subdomain>.oast.fun. The oast.fun service is an out-of-band interaction / callback collector used to confirm code execution and enumerate reachable installer environments; the hostname is embedded in the DNS label so it is captured by the operator's interactsh listener. The script performs no build, native-compile, or install task — its sole effect is to exfiltrate an installer identifier to an attacker-controlled OOB endpoint on every npm install.
